_readme: Queue written by the daily-reel-render task, drained by tools/apply_additions.py during tools/sync.bat. The task must NOT edit calendar.md or review-state.json directly - it queues here instead, and sync.bat folds these in AFTER pulling, on top of whatever the desk decided today. That is what stops the two files conflicting. Adds only: an existing calendar row (keyed on date + post title) is left exactly as the desk left it, and so is an existing review-state key - with one exception, the render flip (content: awaiting-render or rerender -> in-review, plus new revisions entries), which is what tells the desk a cut now exists. It can never write an approval; see the module docstring in tools/apply_additions.py.

revisions.changed: Restored the approved script's full-length scene kickers, which v1 had shortened to fit the 900px text column. render_v3.py now auto-fits the kicker instead: largest integer size up to 34px that fits, floor 80% (27px), raising SystemExit below that rather than overflowing. Scene 2 stays at 34px, scene 6 renders at 29px, scene 4 at 28px. Nothing else changed - same nine scenes, same rule cards, exact CFR via encode.py, 29.50s, longest sustained dull-orange run 0.20s. v1 archived as reel16-travel-doesnt-stop-play.v1.mp4.
